name: calendar-lag-backward
why: The backward pass converts a calendar lag with 'on or before'. b has 2 days of float, yet a has none: a weekend and a holiday sit between them, so a one-day slip of a moves b by three working days.

a.why: b's latest start is index 8 = Fri 12 Mar; minus 4 calendar days = Mon 8 Mar. The last finish whose instant is on or before Mon 8 is index 5 (ending Fri 5, instant Sat 6). Finishing one day later (Tue 9) gives instant Wed 10 + 4 = Sun 14, so b could not start before Mon 15 = index 9 > 8. LF 5, TF 0.

b.why: Instant Sat 6 Mar + 4 = Wed 10 Mar = index 6. LF = PF 10, LS 8.

c.why: Unlinked; sets PF 10. Index 9 = Mon 15 Mar.
